question: Which of the following states is associated with the dance drama folk theatre from 'Yakshagana'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yakshagana** is a traditional theatre form of Karnataka.
 
• The literal meaning is **"The Song of Yaksha"**
 
• It was developed in **Udupi District.**
 
• It is a temple art form that reflects mythological stories, Ramayana, Mahabharat, and other Hindu epics.
 
• It is strongly influenced by **Vaishnav Bhakti Movement.**
 
• Usually recited in **Kannada, Malayalam, and Tuliu. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** Other dance forms**

 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh - Kuchipudi**
 
• **Telangana - Perini**
 
• **Kerala - Mohiniyattam**
